upgrade.description: Once you enter your credentials, your config entry will now automatically set up a panel for you in the UI with the specified name and icon. Once this is complete, you can remove the `panel_iframe` in your configuration.yaml if you created one for this entry. If your credentials don't work, validate that the server host is an HTTPS endpoint and that your credentials are correct.

data_description.device_types: Smart Motion and Smart Occupancy Sensors from Scrypted's object detection plugin are always included. Other Sensor devices are often bridged from integrations Home Assistant already has, such as Ring, UniFi Protect or MQTT. Selecting Notifier adds a switch that mutes each Scrypted app's notifications; anyone with Home Assistant access can then mute any household member's phone.
data_description.excluded_plugins: Devices from these plugins never get entities, whatever their type. Use it for plugins that bridge devices Home Assistant already integrates. Excluding the object detection plugin also hides its smart sensors.
